title: Reading Drill — The Paper Ticket Archive
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: The Paper Ticket Archive
passages.body:
**A** A cinema received a shoebox of old ticket stubs with no dates. An archivist examined the names and a serial number on each ticket, then matched several with programmes from the same period.

**B** The serial numbers were useful within a single roll but restarted whenever staff replaced it. The archivist learned to treat them as local evidence of order rather than a calendar for the whole collection.

**C** One set of stubs had a handwritten note on the back. The note referred to a matinee that the printed programmes omitted, so the archive created a new record and marked its date as uncertain.
